# G2B

> G2B provides comprehensive company formation, banking, and compliance services across multiple jurisdictions including the USA, UK, Singapore, Vietnam, and Hong Kong.

G2B is a GLODIVAL subsidiary specializing in international business expansion and incorporation services. The platform helps entrepreneurs and businesses establish legal entities, open bank accounts, and maintain regulatory compliance across key global markets in North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific regions.

## Key Topics

- Company Formation
- Incorporation Services
- Delaware LLC
- Singapore PTE LTD
- Vietnam LLC/JSC
- Hong Kong Company
- UK LTD/LLP
- Bank Account Setup
- Annual Compliance
- KYC (Know Your Customer)
- Digital Banking
- Global Expansion
- International Payments
- Multi-Country Support
- Business Registration

## Incorporation Services

- [Delaware Incorporation Service - Setting Up Company In The USA](https://g2b.co/services/delaware-incorporation-service): Delaware LLC formation and annual compliance service for US business setup
- [Singapore Incorporation Service - Company Formation And Bank Account](https://g2b.co/services/singapore-incorporation-service): Singapore PTE LTD formation with banking and AGM compliance support
- [Vietnam Incorporation Service - Setting Up Company In Vietnam](https://g2b.co/services/vietnam-incorporation-service): Vietnam LLC/JSC incorporation and compliance service for Asia-Pacific expansion
- [Hong Kong Incorporation Service - Company Formation And Bank Account](https://g2b.co/services/hong-kong-incorporation-service): Hong Kong company formation with bank account setup and Asian market access
- [United Kingdom Incorporation Service - Setting Up Company In The UK](https://g2b.co/services/united-kingdom-incorporation-service): UK LTD/LLP formation with compliance and tax advantage guidance
